name: GitHub (MCP)
description: Gives Engineering, QA and Product GitHub tools (repos, issues, PRs, Actions, code search) through GitHub's official MCP server. Sign in with GitHub in the browser — no tokens to paste.
author: REX

commands.title: GitHub: Triage open issues into a plan
commands.prompt: Using the GitHub tools, list open issues in this project's repository, cluster them, rank by impact/effort, and propose a sprint plan.

commands.title: GitHub: Draft release notes from merged PRs
commands.prompt: Using the GitHub tools, gather PRs merged since the last release and draft release notes grouped by Features, Fixes, and Internal.

connections.name: GitHub
connections.description: Repos, issues, pull requests, Actions and code search.
connections.authCommand: command -v gh >/dev/null || brew install gh; gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || gh auth login --web --git-protocol https --hostname github.com
connections.setupHint: Click Connect: GitHub opens in your browser; enter the code REX shows and approve.
